title: Navigation, tables, dashboards
summary: Navigation, tables, dashboards operational rules curated for Zanker. Independent synthesis; consult primary sources for exact normative requirements.

rules.title: Data table scanning
rules.intent: Use alignment, sorting and meaningful grouping for expert decisions
principles: Use alignment, sorting and meaningful grouping for expert decisions
antiPatterns: Decorative cards replacing every dense table

rules.title: Useful empty state
rules.intent: Explain why there is no content and offer next step when appropriate
principles: Explain why there is no content and offer next step when appropriate
antiPatterns: Empty blank viewport with no guidance
acceptance: Empty fixture has a coherent message

rules.title: Filter and sorting state
rules.intent: Make active constraints visible and reversible
principles: Make active constraints visible and reversible
antiPatterns: Hidden sticky filters producing surprising results

rules.title: Task-driven dashboards
rules.intent: Prioritize decision-ready information over vanity metrics
principles: Prioritize decision-ready information over vanity metrics
antiPatterns: Lots of charts without next steps
acceptance: Each critical chart has a question it answers

rules.title: Navigation affordance
rules.intent: Distinguish links, actions and selections clearly
principles: Distinguish links, actions and selections clearly
antiPatterns: Text visually identical to clickable controls

rules.title: Icon and label alignment
rules.intent: Use stable icon meanings supported by text when ambiguous
principles: Use stable icon meanings supported by text when ambiguous
antiPatterns: Swapping arbitrary icons purely for variety
acceptance: Navigation labels and icons tested for clarity
